title: Unsafe Diffusion: On the Generation of Unsafe Images and Hateful Memes From Text-To-Image Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking the safety of Text-to-Image models regarding the generation of 'unsafe' content, such as violence and hateful memes. While the study mentions targeting the Pope as a community figure in hateful memes and includes 'hateful' as a category, its primary focus is on model safety vulnerabilities and content moderation rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics as a core academic component.
